Poached chicken egg, whole: Whole egg cooked in simmering water for 3-5 minutes, then drained. Egg white is set while egg yolk remains runny, deshelled before serving.

Food Name: Trace: Nutrient is present in quantities too low to be measured with acceptable precision (i.e. below the minimum detection limit)
Dash (-): No data is available for this nutrient
Per 100g: Nutrient data reported in the column is per 100g edible portion
Per serving size (g): Nutrient data reported in the column is calculated based on total weight of edible and non-edible portions (e.g. includes weight of bones and herbs)
• There will be differences in reported nutrient data per 100g edible portion and per 100g serving size if edible portion is less than 100%
